aboutGame.title: What is Void Runners?
paragraphs: Void Runners is a twin-stick roguelike for one to four players on a couch or online, developed and published by Aaron Reisman. Each pair of ships is joined by a beam that shreds whatever it sweeps, so where you fly relative to your crew is the core decision.

A run crosses three sectors of four jumps and ends at a guardian. Along the way you spread out and swing the web, use crossfire, dodge, revive crew from escape pods, and build a salvaged ship. The Steam page marks the game as coming soon with a Q1 2027 release window, and does not publish ship parts, weapon stats, boss names, or a code system.

modules.name: Void Runners Beginner Guide
modules.description: This module introduces new players to the core gameplay loop, co-op beam mechanics, ship control, salvage runs, and basic strategies. It helps beginners understand how to survive early sectors and build effective crews.

highlights.detail: Read your crewmate's position, because your beam links the two of you and shreds what it sweeps.
Spread out and swing the web so crossfire covers more space without clipping a teammate.
Practice dodging and beam positioning before you push into deeper jumps.
Take only the easy salvage while you are still learning the three-sector route.
Keep a plan for reviving crew from escape pods rather than flying in blind.
Remember a run crosses three sectors of four jumps and ends at a guardian.

items.question: What is Void Runners?
items.answer: Void Runners is a twin-stick roguelike for one to four players on a couch or online, developed and published by Aaron Reisman. Each pair of ships is joined by a beam that shreds whatever it sweeps, so where you fly relative to your crew is the core decision.

items.question: Is Void Runners playable solo or in co-op?
items.answer: It is documented for one to four players on one couch or online. Where you position relative to your crew matters because of the linking beams.

items.question: How do Void Runners codes work?
items.answer: No code system is published on the store page. Treat any claim of active codes as unverified until the developer announces one.

items.question: What should I learn first in Void Runners?
items.answer: Start with beam positioning: spreading out and swinging the web so your beams sweep what you want without clipping a crewmate, plus dodging and revive awareness.

items.question: Does Void Runners have boss fights?
items.answer: Yes. A run crosses three sectors of four jumps and ends at a guardian. Specific boss names and attack patterns are not published.

items.question: How do I progress in Void Runners?
items.answer: The store page says you build a salvaged ship and go three sectors and three guardians deep. Specific currency names and upgrade costs are not documented.
